attacchi.effetto: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.
Search your deck for up to 2 Supporter cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Count the number of cards in your opponent's hand. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.
Search your opponent's discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack. (The Supporter card remains in your opponent's discard pile.)
Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of either player's Evolved Pokémon, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokémon, and put it into that player's hand.

If your opponent's Bench isn't full, look at his or her hand. Choose 1 Basic Pokémon you find there and put it onto your opponent's Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch.

Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If 2 of them are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If all of them are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Count the number of your Pokémon that have any damage counters on them. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.
Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards and attach them to any of your Pokémon (excluding Pokémon that already have a Pokémon Tool attached to them). Shuffle your deck afterward.
Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch. The new Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.
Flip a coin. If heads, switch all damage counters on Unown with those on the Defending Pokémon. (If an effect of this attack is prevented, this attack does nothing.)
You may discard any Stadium card in play.
Flip a coin. If heads, put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 10 HP away from being Knocked Out.

Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it on that Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) If you do, put 1 damage counter on Unown. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Remove 5 damage counters from Unown. (All if there are less than 5.)
Return Unown and all Energy cards attached to it to your hand.
Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon that already has damage counters on it.
Search your deck for up to 3 different types of basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent returns the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to his or her hand. (If your opponent doesn't have any Benched Pokémon or other Active Pokémon, this attack does nothing.)
If the Defending Pokémon has a Poké-Power or a Poké-Body, choose up to 2 basic Energy cards attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and attach them to the Defending Pokémon.
Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.
Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Basic Pokémon and each Evolution card in your discard pile. You can't add more than 60 damage in this way.
Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.
Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
Does 20 damage to each Pokémon that has any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies (both yours and your opponent's). Don't apply Weakness or Resistance.
